import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FastScanner {
        InputStream in;
        byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        int off, len;

        FastScanner(InputStream in) {
            this.in = in;
        }

        int read() throws IOException {
            if (off >= len) {
                len = in.read(buf);
                off = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[off++];
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c;
            do {
                c = read();
            } while (c <= ' ' && c != -1);
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int val = 0;
            while (c > ' ') {
                val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = read();
            }
            return sign * val;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastScanner in = new FastScanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        if (n > 40) {
            out.println(0);
            out.close();
            return;
        }

        long[][] points = new long[n][5];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; ++j) {
                points[i][j] = in.nextInt();
            }
        }

        if (n < 3) {
            out.println(n);
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) out.println(i);
            out.close();
            return;
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int center = 0; center < n; ++center) {
            boolean bad = false;
            search:
            for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a) {
                if (a == center) continue;
                for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b) {
                    if (b == center || b == a) continue;
                    if (positiveScalar(points[a], points[center], points[b])) {
                        bad = true;
                        break search;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!bad) result.add(center + 1);
        }

        out.println(result.size());
        for (int id : result) out.println(id);
        out.close();
    }

    static boolean positiveScalar(long[] x, long[] c, long[] y) {
        long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
            sum += (x[i] - c[i]) * (y[i] - c[i]);
        }
        return sum > 0;
    }
}

import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        new Solver().solve(in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class Solver {
        void solve(Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = in.nextInt();

            if (n > 40) {
                out.println(0);
                return;
            }

            Point[] pts = new Point[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                pts[i] = new Point(in.nextInt(), in.nextInt(), in.nextInt(), in.nextInt(), in.nextInt());
            }

            if (n < 3) {
                out.println(n);
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) out.println(i);
                return;
            }

            boolean[] good = new boolean[n];
            Arrays.fill(good, true);

            outer:
            for (int c = 0; c < n; ++c) {
                for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a) {
                    if (a == c) continue;
                    Point fromA = pts[a].minus(pts[c]);

                    for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b) {
                        if (b == c || b == a) continue;
                        if (fromA.dot(pts[b].minus(pts[c]))) {
                            good[c] = false;
                            continue outer;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            int count = 0;
            for (boolean b : good) {
                if (b) ++count;
            }

            out.println(count);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (good[i]) out.println(i + 1);
            }
        }

        static class Point {
            long a, b, c, d, e;

            Point(long a, long b, long c, long d, long e) {
                this.a = a;
                this.b = b;
                this.c = c;
                this.d = d;
                this.e = e;
            }

            Point minus(Point rhs) {
                return new Point(a - rhs.a, b - rhs.b, c - rhs.c, d - rhs.d, e - rhs.e);
            }

            boolean dot(Point rhs) {
                return a * rhs.a + b * rhs.b + c * rhs.c + d * rhs.d + e * rhs.e > 0;
            }
        }
    }
}
